description: Look up a saved selector by key for a site and return it, ready to pass as the selector of click, type, get_text, and similar tools. Fails if no hint with that key exists for the domain; use selector_hint_list to see what is saved.

domain.description: Site hostname, e.g. 'www.saucedemo.com'. Defaults to the hostname of the page currently open.

key.description: Short name for the element, e.g. 'login_button' or 'search_box' (1-128 chars).

name: selector_hint_get
